layers.process: Iberá National Park: entry through any portal (Cambyretá, San Nicolás, Laguna Iberá or Carambola) is free. The only requirement is to register with the park staff or complete the self-registration at the public-use area. APN's fee table lists an Iberá daily pass (general ARS 25,000, about A$23.19), but APN says charging at Iberá and several other parks starts only once the access-control infrastructure and services are in place. (No RBA rate for ARS; at the Banco Central de la República Argentina rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 1,078.2486 ARS).

public_holidays: 2027-04-02 (Friday): Día de la Reafirmación de la Soberanía Nacional over the Malvinas, South Atlantic islands, Argentine Antarctic Sector and Corrientes combatants in those islands, a permanent provincial holiday (Ley 4099, article 1, official texto actualizado). Ley 4911 repealed article 2 of Ley 4099 and made this holiday immovable. The same date is also the national Malvinas veterans' day; this record does not restate the national law.
culture-cycles.note: Official Digesto de Leyes Provinciales PDFs of Ley 4099 (sanctioned 4 September 1986) and Ley 4911 (sanctioned 16 February 1995) were read directly on 11 November 2026, including the digesto's texto actualizado of Ley 4099, in which article 2 is marked repealed by Ley 4911. Ley 6494, also listed in the official digesto search for feriado, declares a permanent holiday in each municipality on that municipality's foundation day. That is not a single province-wide date and is not recorded here as a provincial public holiday. Municipal foundation days and later amendments not in these texts were not checked.
